# VisionBridge

VisionBridge is a browser-based Indian Sign Language (ISL) A–Z recognition application.

## Application
- Sign in: https://visionbridge-2c7h.onrender.com/login
- Dashboard: https://visionbridge-2c7h.onrender.com/dashboard
- Live Translate: https://visionbridge-2c7h.onrender.com/translate
- Calibration: https://visionbridge-2c7h.onrender.com/calibration
- Letter History: https://visionbridge-2c7h.onrender.com/history
- Settings: https://visionbridge-2c7h.onrender.com/settings
- Voice to Sign: https://visionbridge-2c7h.onrender.com/voice-to-sign
- Word Bank: https://visionbridge-2c7h.onrender.com/word-bank

## Capabilities
- Real-time browser camera hand tracking
- Indian Sign Language A–Z letter recognition
- Few-shot signer calibration
- Recognition history and CSV export
- Signer-specific adapter management
- Voice-to-Sign speech input with animated A–Z fingerspelling
- Categorized daily vocabulary, custom phrases, and ten-slot persistent Quick Access

## Technical context
VisionBridge uses React, TypeScript, Vite, React Router, MediaPipe Hand Landmarker, and a 126-dimensional two-hand landmark pipeline.

## Access
Most application routes require authentication.
- My Profile: https://visionbridge-2c7h.onrender.com/personalization
- Personalization stores named context profiles with avatar, Quick Access, favorites, signing speed, and preferred speech voice.
